added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own arms: base-arm.log at 6ccf43de9 records 4, 29, 19 and 8 passed with EXIT=0 and no failing id; head-arm.log at ea95f45c7 records the same 4, 29, 19 and 8 passed with EXIT=0. Both arms are readable (four file-exit lines each, summary line reached, bare EXIT= line last), so the added failure set is empty.

findings.text: non-blocking: The arms table's row 1 cites repro2.log for 'cold carrier build, oracle_fixture.build_machine(case, -500) - built, 553 realised cells', and that log records the opposite. repro2.log is 11 lines: 'kind=limited cells=550 then' a traceback ending in FileNotFoundError: certified carrier is absent: sha256:79ae5d8473..., raised from scripts/prototypes/fast_map_production/solver.py:119 through a repro.py whose line 32 and line 58 do not exist in the committed scripts/prototypes/limited_550_carrier/repro.py, so the log also predates the driver that landed. It carries no EXIT= line and no realised_cells figure. The verdict survives because repro3.log independently shows the cold build (realised_cells=553 cache_hit=False) plus both from_cells calls and TopologyGeometry, so the row should be re-pointed at repro3.log and repro2.log recorded as a superseded attempt rather than a completed arm.

non-blocking: The module-scoped fixture cold-builds the 553-cell carrier, which cost 118.85 s at head and 201.68 s at base in the recorded arms, yet the module carries no @pytest.mark.slow. The repository default is addopts = "-rfEs --doctest-modules -m 'not slow'" with timeout = 300 (pyproject.toml:282,284), so this module runs in every default lane and sits within 100 s of the per-test bound; the sibling test that exercises the same carrier, tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py:54, is marked @pytest.mark.slow with @pytest.mark.timeout(900). A warm cache keeps the cost small, but a cold lane will pay it and a slower cold build will be killed as a timeout rather than reported.

item_verdicts.call_sites: No production source changed, so no runtime code reaches the diff; I verified the three production owners the new test drives all accept this carrier at base 6ccf43de9: nova/equilibrium/separatrix_clip.py:1924 AtomicCellMesh.from_cells returns 553 centroids with cell_vertex_count >= 3, nova/equilibrium/topology.py:2524 TopologyGeometry.from_cells builds 553 centres and areas, and scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py:1112 forward_operator builds 553 moment cells.
item_verdicts.diff: Read both commits against base 6ccf43de9: ea95f45c7 adds tests/test_limited_550_carrier.py (74 lines, four tests over one shared carrier fixture), scripts/prototypes/limited_550_carrier/repro.py and forward_repro.py (88 lines of reproduction drivers); 2a02f59ec adds only docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/limited-550-carrier.html (24 lines). No product source and no figure changed, and the four changed paths are all inside the declared write grants.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when asks for 0 added failures between base and head arms over test files importing the changed modules; base-arm.log and head-arm.log each carry four per-file pytest processes with separate basetemps and end EXIT=0, 60 passed at each end and no failing id, so the measure is 0 added failures. The vehicle is the one deviation: the done-when names 'one sirius job' and the arms ran in place on the fleet allocation (job 1291586, 98dci4-clu-2068, sequentially, one process at a time), which the dispatch's HOST block directs; the manifest does not record that substitution.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to find why AtomicCellMesh.from_cells refuses the limited 550-cell carrier and repair it; the run establishes by measurement that nothing refuses it (repro3.log: raw and canonical polygons both atomise to 1,346 nodes, 553 cells, cold cache_hit=False) and therefore ships a passing regression test and the evidence record instead of a repair, which is the outcome the worker contract sanctions when the behaviour is already correct.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read in full; it lists commits ea95f45c7 and 2a02f59ec, four changed paths all inside the grants, three reproduce logs plus the row re-render, both arm logs with their JSON arms (revision, command, exit_status 0, completed true, failure_count 0, empty failure_ids), the negative control at negative-control-mutant.log with EXIT=1 and four not-passing ids, and a rubric line for all six dimensions.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The run's fence grants nova/equilibrium/atomic_cells.py, benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py, tests/test_limited_550_carrier.py, scripts/prototypes/limited_550_carrier, docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/limited-550-carrier.html and docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/limited-550-carrier; git diff --stat 6ccf43de9..2a02f59ec touches only the test file, the two prototype drivers and the fragment, with nothing outside the grants.

justifications.durability: tests/test_limited_550_carrier.py:43-72 asserts against independent values (the literal 553 realised cells, cell_vertex_count >= 3, finite centroids and nodes, one positive full_area per cell, one moment cell), and negative-control-mutant.log shows those four ids going not-passing with EXIT=1 when an injected refusal is put back into AtomicCellMesh.from_cells, so the guard does redden on the regression it names, though it reddens at fixture setup rather than in the test bodies.
justifications.evidence: Both arms are readable receipts and the base and head summaries reconcile at 0 added failures, but docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/limited-550-carrier.html:14 cites repro2.log for a completed cold build when that log records a FileNotFoundError and no EXIT line, and the arms ran on the fleet allocation rather than in the sirius job the done-when names.
justifications.fit: tests/test_limited_550_carrier.py follows the surrounding idiom (configure_dtypes before the numpy/JAX imports, an oracle_fixture carrier, a module-scoped machine fixture, names by owner rather than by plan label), but it omits the @pytest.mark.slow that the sibling 550-cell test tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py:54 carries for the same cold build.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/limited-550-carrier.html:19 records that no predicate fired and repro3.log backs it, which answers 'why is it refused' with 'it is not', and the sanctioned fallback (pin the working behaviour) is delivered; the repair half of the goal is correctly declined rather than faked, but the premise is left as an unreproduced report with no pointer to the revision the reporter measured.
justifications.reuse: Tests/test_limited_550_carrier.py:32-40 builds its carrier through the existing scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py:897 cached_machine and reference_cases()['weak-rotation-reactor'].static_limit() rather than rebuilding a generator, and a search over tests/ and scripts/prototypes/ for carrier-acceptance assertions found tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py asserting root tangents, not carrier acceptance, so no owned mechanism is duplicated.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 6ccf43de9..2a02f59ec lists only tests/test_limited_550_carrier.py, scripts/prototypes/limited_550_carrier/repro.py, scripts/prototypes/limited_550_carrier/forward_repro.py and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/limited-550-carrier.html, every one inside the declared grants, and the benchmark's render side effect is recorded as restored byte-for-byte under outside_scope.
